name: Comptacop
positioning: A full web-based condo management software for professional and volunteer syndics, from accounting to general assemblies.
description: Comptacop is a French web-based ("100% Internet Full Web") software for managing condo syndicates, in operation for over ten years. It covers accounting (budgets, journal, general ledger, trial balance, charge allocation, year-end closing annexes), meter readings, bank reconciliation with Excel export, and a co-owner extranet with an agenda and general-assembly tools, sold as a single all-inclusive plan for either professional or volunteer syndics.
real_estate_use: A syndic — professional or volunteer — logs into Comptacop to prepare the provisional budget, record works, subsidies and loans, and produce the year-end closing annexes required by French co-ownership regulation, without switching tools between accounting and administration. Co-owners consult the extranet to see their balances and shared documents outside of general assemblies. Because the plan is unlimited on the number of condos managed, a small syndic firm can run its whole portfolio on one subscription.
features: Condo accounting: budgets, general ledger, trial balance, year-end annexes
Automated charge allocation and fund calls
Co-owner extranet with agenda and general-assembly tools
Unlimited number of managed condos on a single subscription

use_cases.job: Run accounting, charge allocation and general assemblies for an unlimited number of condos on one subscription
Consult balances and building documents through the co-owner extranet
